style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: Make your Christmas pretty in pink with this stunning artificial tree from HOMCOM. Standing at 6ft, it’s perfect for medium and large-sized rooms, featuring 892 branch tips for a full and voluptuous look that stands beautifully. Its sturdy construction ensures it can hold both decorations and tinsel securely in place, making it easy to decorate however you like. The tree comes complete with a removable base to keep it balanced, and the top branch provides space for your star or angel topper. The vibrant pink color adds a modern touch to your festive decor. The tree is easy to assemble and disassemble, with pieces that fit together effortlessly. Recommended setup time is 25-30 minutes. Please note, ornaments are not included. Tree dimensions: F110 x 180Hcm, with a height of 6ft and 892 tips (720 PVC, 172 PE). Materials include PVC, PE, and steel, and the item label is 830-355V02.
